$WISH ✨ The community coin behind Wishwave.

Wishwave is the marketplace for the experience economy. Real people share their talents in real life: yoga teachers, private chefs, massage therapists, tarot readers, DJs, musicians, mentors and more. They set their price, guests book in a few taps. They come to you, or you go to them.

🛠 What $WISH does
Creator rewards from trading go toward building the Wishwave app. How much that is depends on trading, so it could be a lot, a little or nothing. We share progress openly.

🎁 Thank-you perks
Supporters get perks when the app launches, like a supporter badge, early access and a first booking experiences. Perks have no cash value and may change.

🌍 The plan
Launch in one major city, then grow city by city, worldwide.

⚠️ Important
$WISH is a meme coin for fun and community. It is not an investment, not a share in Wishwave, and has no promise of profit. The price can go to zero. Only spend what you can afford to lose. Not financial advice. Adults only.
